method: Additive registry: records here are merged by scripts/media/build-media.mjs on top of media-reviewed.json and attributions.json, which stay untouched.
Each asset was found by a targeted Wikimedia Commons search for one month's theme chosen in docs/temporadas-auditoria.md (the image follows the data).
Reviewed visually on 330–500 px previews. Licence, author and description read from the Commons file page (extmetadata) on 2026-10-06.
